description: Analyze the structure of one or more dashboards.

dashboards.description: One or more dashboard references to analyze. Each reference can be: - a Sisense dashboard ID, or - a dashboard title (name). At least one dashboard reference is required. At runtime this method is tolerant of a single string being passed instead of a list, and will normalize it to a one-element list.

examples.user_query: Analyze the structure of the dashboard titled 'Sales Overview'.
examples.notes: This call analyzes the structure of the 'Sales Overview' dashboard, counting widget types and identifying child dashboards.

examples.user_query: Check the structure of dashboards with IDs 'dashboard123' and 'dashboard456'.
examples.notes: This call processes two dashboards by their IDs, providing insights into widget counts and jump-to-dashboard relationships.

examples.user_query: Analyze the complexity of the dashboard named 'Marketing Performance'.
examples.notes: This call evaluates the 'Marketing Performance' dashboard for widget counts and child dashboard references, useful for understanding its structure.

description: Compute widget counts for one or more dashboards.

dashboards.description: One or more dashboard references to analyze. Each reference can be: - a Sisense dashboard ID, or - a dashboard title (name). At least one dashboard reference is required. At runtime this method is tolerant of a single string being passed instead of a list, and will normalize it to a one-element list.

examples.user_query: Count the widgets on the 'Sales Overview' and 'Marketing Performance' dashboards.
examples.notes: This call analyzes the widget counts for the dashboards titled 'Sales Overview' and 'Marketing Performance'. Use this when you need a quick summary of widget counts for specific dashboards by title.

examples.user_query: Can you check the widget count for the dashboard with ID 'dashboard_12345'?
examples.notes: This call retrieves the widget count for the dashboard identified by the Sisense dashboard ID 'dashboard_12345'. Use this when you know the dashboard ID and want to analyze its widget count.

examples.user_query: I need to know the widget counts for dashboards 'dashboard_67890' and 'Executive Summary'.
examples.notes: This call computes widget counts for a mix of dashboard references: one by ID ('dashboard_67890') and one by title ('Executive Summary'). Use this when you have a combination of IDs and titles to analyze.

description: Analyze pivot widgets on one or more dashboards and report those with many fields.

dashboards.description: One or more dashboard references to analyze. Each reference can be: - a Sisense dashboard ID, or - a dashboard title (name). At least one dashboard reference is required. At runtime this method is tolerant of a single string being passed instead of a list, and will normalize it to a one-element list.

max_fields.description: Threshold for the number of fields on a pivot widget. Only pivot widgets with more than this number of fields are included in the returned data. Defaults to 20.

examples.user_query: Find pivot widgets with more than 25 fields on the 'Sales Dashboard' and 'Marketing Dashboard' dashboards.
examples.notes: This call analyzes the 'Sales Dashboard' and 'Marketing Dashboard' to identify pivot widgets with more than 25 fields. Use this to ensure widgets remain manageable and performant.

examples.user_query: Check all pivot widgets on dashboard ID '12345' for excessive fields.
examples.notes: This call checks the dashboard with ID '12345' for pivot widgets that exceed the default threshold of 20 fields. Useful for auditing a specific dashboard by its ID.

examples.user_query: Audit pivot widgets on multiple dashboards for field counts above 30.
examples.notes: This call reviews the 'Finance Dashboard', 'Operations Dashboard', and 'HR Dashboard' for pivot widgets with more than 30 fields. Ideal for a broader audit across multiple dashboards.
